title: viable/strict/1794561742: [CD] Remove TH_BINARY_BUILD (#204482)
excerpt: TH_BINARY_BUILD is a leftover from the TH era that the wheel build scripts export to mean "this is a release binary build". The only remaining consumers are two MAGMA-related link tweaks, and both can be expressed in terms of the actual build configuration instead of an environment variable: caffe2/CMakeLists.txt : Note [Extra MKL symbols for MAGMA in torch_cpu] forces a few mkl_lapack_* symbols into torch_cpu so that MAGMA's CPU fallbacks in torch_cuda resolve against it instead of statically pulling MKL into torch_cuda . The symbols only exist when MKL is the BLAS, so gate it on CAFFE2_USE_MKL AND USE_CUDA (Linux only, as before). x86_64 CUDA wheels are unchanged; aarch64 CUDA wheels (no MKL, no MAGMA) no longer get the no-op --undefined flags. aten/src/ATen/CMakeLists.txt : on Windows, link ${BLAS_LIBRARIES} into torch_cuda whenever building with MAGMA. Wheels are unchanged, and source builds with MAGMA need it as well since DLLs must resolve all symbols at link time. With those in place, drop the variable from the Linux (CUDA, CPU, XPU, ROCm), Windows and macOS wheel build environments. Test Plan: CD wheel builds, via the ciflow/binaries label; the x86_64 CUDA wheel link line for torch_cpu should be unchanged. This PR was authored with the help of an AI assistant (Claude Code).
